messages.text: Hi! If I order the KBOX today, when would it ship and arrive in Florida ((postcode ····))? The page shows both Sept 30 and Oct 31. I need it by Oct 5. Thanks!
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe NerdQaxe Hammer BC04 in stock miner
Handed to the team · conflicting ship dates on the KBOX listing; cannot confirm a date myself

I wouldn't count on the KBOX for Oct 5. It's $800 and runs on about a 19 day lead time, so ordering today puts it well past that, and the two dates on the page contradict each other. I've asked the team to confirm the real one, they pick that up today at 10am ET and it comes to your email.

If Oct 5 is firm, the in-stock picks that ship from the US warehouse in a few days are the NerdQX (8 TH/s, $299.99) or the Hammer BC04 (6 TH/s, $239). Want a link to either?
Correction: I actually need it by Oct 14, not Oct 5. Would the KBOX make it to Florida ((postcode ····)) by then? Thanks

Still can't promise it. On the roughly 19 day lead time, ordering today puts the KBOX shipping around Oct 18, then transit to (address hidden) on top, so Oct 14 is behind it. And with the page showing two different dates I won't commit to either until the team confirms which is real, which happens today at 10am ET and lands in your email.

If the date matters more than the 22 TH/s, the NerdQX at $299.99 ships from the US warehouse within a few days and would comfortably make the 14th. Want that link?
